final_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese technology blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a wide conceptual cover about the foundations of distributed systems. Theme: independent nodes communicating through an uncertain network must choose among consistency, availability, latency, and progress. Summary angle: two node fortresses face each other across a misty broken network gorge while a single glowing message token travels between them; the center of the gorge shows a controlled three-way tension, and several messengers coordinate without a shared clock. Narrative flow: layered reveal. Information blocks: first, delayed and interrupted paths between the fortresses represent the uncertain network and are labeled exactly '网络'; second, three restrained forces around the central token represent the CAP and PACELC tradeoffs and are labeled exactly '取舍'; third, messengers attempting to meet around an irregular clockless ring represent the FLP consensus boundary and are labeled exactly '共识'. Main metaphor: martial artists carrying one shared seal across a changing landscape while preserving a common agreement. Primary subject: one luminous message seal at the center, with the two fortresses and a few human messengers only supporting its story. Composition: wide central-gorge composition, left and right fortresses create system relationships, strong motion arcs guide the eye toward the central seal, ample negative space, readable at thumbnail size. Style/medium: combine abstract technical concept art with bold martial-arts comic look, expressive ink strokes, dramatic stances, gritty texture, strong motion arcs. Use ink black, aged-paper ivory, restrained cinnabar red, and cool blue-gray. Visible text policy: render only '网络', '取舍', and '共识'; no title, sentences, English slogans, formulas, extra labels, numbers, fake UI, watermark, or prompt residue. Constraints: one dominant central seal, 2-4 supporting narrative beats, abstract system relationships without a real architecture diagram, no product logos, no screenshots, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage. Avoid generic robots, code rain, neon city backgrounds, giant HUD overlays, dense equations, decorative clutter, excessive characters, gore, and illegible microtext.
